value.rationale: In the smallest genuinely interacting disordered exclusion ring, full fluctuation spectra and current large deviations preserve reversal symmetry even where particle-hole mean-current symmetry fails. This distinguishes a full counting-statistics obstruction to rectification from known mean-only cancellation, with a natural exact finite-size boundary.
